description: Register an iOS app's bundle ID and App ID Prefix with an instance, like adding an iOS app on the Clerk Dashboard's Native applications page. Returns the registered app, with its id, bundle_id, and app_id_prefix. Clerk needs the registration for native sign-in with Clerk's iOS SDK, and before patch_instance_config can set the app's minimum version (native_app_minimum_versions). Check list_native_applications first. The same bundle ID can be registered again under a different App ID Prefix, for example after the app moves to another Apple developer team, so confirm the prefix before adding a second one. Registering the same bundle ID and prefix again is rejected, and so is a bundle ID that differs from a registered one only in capitalization. To change or remove a registration, use the Clerk Dashboard. Then run enable_native_api if it isn't enabled.

app_id_prefix.description: The app's ten-character Apple App ID Prefix, such as ABCDE12345. For most apps it's the Apple Developer Team ID; confirm it on the app's identifier in the Apple Developer portal.

bundle_id.description: The app's bundle ID, exactly as Xcode spells it, such as com.example.app.

instance.description: Instance to target: "development", "production", or a full instance ID (ins_…).
